svg.title: Well water treatment order: master diagram of twelve positions with rules and failures
svg.desc: Master well water treatment order from well and pump, aeration, chemical feed and pressure tank through sediment screen, retention tank, acid neutralizer, iron filter, carbon filter and water softener to UV disinfection and kitchen RO, with the rule for each position and what fails if it is moved.
svg.text: Well water treatment order: every position, its rule, its failure
Install only the stages your test calls for, but always in this order
What fails if it is moved
Vents to air, so it must come
so the tank adds contact time
stages below it see no surges
Stages ahead of it take every
too fine here clogs with iron
Raises pH ahead of iron media
the UV sleeve and RO membrane
Ahead of iron or carbon: resin
only if the lab test calls for it
A hard well with otherwise clean chemistry may need only positions 1, 4, 5 and 10.
